findings.detail: The current EX5 is byte-identical to the routed pre-rework Gemini binary, while the MQ5 was changed by commit e59303901 to fix card exits and loss controls. No governed COMPILE_OK binds that source to a new binary.
The EURUSD, AUDCAD, and USDCAD setfiles carry three different build_hash values, and none equals the current MQ5 SHA-256. The executable/setfile/source bundle is not deterministic.

positive_checks: The unauthorized 1R fallback is removed; an invalid SMA-midline target now rejects the setup.
The 2.0% daily entry halt, 2.5% daily hard stop, and 5.0% total drawdown controls are implemented fail-closed.

All 3 backtest setfiles use RISK_FIXED=1000 and RISK_PERCENT=0.
required_action: Regenerate all three setfiles from one reviewed source identity and run the governed compile path to produce a COMPILE_OK EX5 bound to that same identity. Keep this Gemini-origin task in REVIEW; do not promote the stale binary to Q02 or PIPELINE.
